caption:
Job + ABN? Your side income is taxed from the first dollar.

A new ABN doesn't come with a new tax-free threshold. The $18,200 applies once, across all your income, and a salary usually uses it up.

So the business profit stacks on top:
- Salary: $80,000
- ABN profit: $20,000
- Tax on that $20,000: about $6,400 (30% plus the 2% Medicare levy, 2026–27)

And nobody withholds it. It arrives as a bill after you lodge.

What helps:
- Claiming the real costs of running the business, which come off the profit before it's taxed.
- Knowing your rate: at this income about 32c of each extra dollar goes to tax.
- The small business tax offset, up to $1,000, worked out automatically for sole traders.

Is your ABN a side hustle or the main thing?

#abn #sidehustle #soletrader #smallbusinessaustralia #australiantax
figures_checked: Tax-free threshold $18,200, claimed from one payer only; all income including side-hustle income must be declared, no minimum; platforms report seller income to the ATO under the Sharing Economy Reporting Regime (ATO Paying tax on multiple sources of income; Joined the bustle of a side hustle, checked 15 Nov 2026)

Resident rates 2026–27: nil to $18,200; 15c to $45,000; $4,020 + 30c to $135,000; $31,020 + 37c to $190,000; $51,370 + 45c above; Medicare levy 2% not included (ATO Tax rates – Australian residents, checked 15 Nov 2026)

Small business income tax offset: 16% of tax on net small business income, capped at $1,000, aggregated turnover under $5 million, sole traders and partners only, 2026–27 (ATO Small business income tax offset, checked 15 Nov 2026)
